purpose: Provider-neutral cross-platform compatibility execution plan; cells are CI_REQUIRED until actually executed.
steps: install the frozen wheel with dependencies from the configured public index or release wheelhouse
record resolved package versions and environment fingerprint
run the complete frozen pytest suite
upload logs, resolved-environment record, and hashes
pass_rule: A cell becomes PASS only after its own runner completes the full frozen suite; metadata compatibility alone is insufficient.

dependency_tracks.minimum_supported: HOLD until per-Python floor environments are independently resolved and executed
dependency_tracks.hash_locked_hermetic: HOLD until platform-specific wheelhouse/lock artifacts are built and replayed
